name: Savor
balance_transfer_fee: $0 at the standard Transfer APR; 3% during the 0% intro period, or 4% at any other promotional APR Capital One may offer

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $500 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening

verdict.text: Keep: unlimited 3% on dining, streaming, entertainment, groceries

earn_rates.category: Grocery stores (excludes superstores like Walmart & Target)
Entertainment: movies, concerts, sporting events, amusement parks
Popular streaming services: Netflix, Hulu, Disney+
Hotels, vacation rentals & rental cars, via Capital One Travel

earn_note: Four uncapped 3% categories with no rotation or activation is unusually generous for a $0 card.

redemption_options.method: Statement credit / check / gift card / Amazon / PayPal

points.note: A straight cash-back currency, not miles: no transfer partners and no premium redemption to chase. Gift card and other redemption rates can vary.

transfer_partners.highlight: Cash back isn't transferable. Redeem it as a statement credit or check, for gift cards, or through Capital One Travel or Entertainment.

insurance.detail: Secondary at home · primary outside your country of residence
$1,500 per insured person on non-refundable common carrier tickets
Delay $100/day up to $300 · lost luggage up to $3,000/trip

protection_note: Better covered than it looks. Capital One's Discover network guide names Savor and grants purchase security, extended warranty, price protection, trip cancellation and interruption, travel accident, baggage delay and lost luggage cover. No trip delay, emergency medical or cell phone cover.
rental_note: Decline the rental counter's own waiver and pay in full with this card. Coverage is secondary at home, but primary when you rent outside your country of residence.

status_perks.name: Hertz Five Star status
status_perks.note: Skip-the-counter access and a wider vehicle selection at select Hertz locations.

services.name: Discover network transition
services.detail: New Savor accounts are being originated on the Discover network instead of Mastercard as of early 2026.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns the same cash-back rates (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add trusted users: an easy way to consolidate household dining/grocery spend onto the flat 3% categories.

timeline.text: The Capital One-Uber partnership's unlimited 10% cash back on Uber/Uber Eats and complimentary Uber One membership expired; it is not part of the card's standing benefits.

The no-fee SavorOne card was renamed Savor, replacing an older fee-charging Savor (4% dining) product that was discontinued. This card is the same no-fee product as the old SavorOne, not a continuation of the original Savor.
